name: Arrivée de star
subtitle: Une photo, et c'est toi que la foule attend
pitch: Tu sors du SUV noir entre tes gardes du corps, les fans te filment au téléphone, puis tu entres au restaurant sous les objectifs. 10 secondes filmées comme une vraie vidéo de fan : il suffit d'une photo.

timeline.shot: SUV fermé, la star n'est pas visible
La porte s'ouvre, la star sort, tête baissée puis de trois quarts
Debout, en pied, entre les gardes du corps
timeline.risk: visage d'environ 40 px, confusion avec les gardes

timeline.shot: Passe de dos et de côté parmi les gardes, la caméra pivote
Réapparaît en pied et marche vers la caméra
Plan moyen de face, sourire : le moment où on juge la ressemblance
timeline.risk: visage d'environ 90 x 120 px, moustache d'origine

timeline.shot: Tourne de profil vers la droite
De dos, entre au restaurant, garde du corps au premier plan

source_requirements.notes_for_user: Une photo de la personne en pied, de face, à la lumière du jour et seule sur la photo. En option, un gros plan de son visage. Évite lunettes de soleil, casquette et photos floues : plus la photo est nette, plus la vidéo lui ressemble.

replace_raw: Replace the main character of @Video1 with the person in @Element1. The main character is the young man with brown wavy hair and a thick mustache, in an open black jacket over a white t-shirt, dark trousers and white sneakers, who steps out of the black SUV, walks between the bodyguards toward the camera and enters the restaurant.

He becomes the person in @Element1 from head to toe in every frame where he appears: same face, hairstyle, hair length and color, skin tone, facial hair or lack of it, apparent age, height and body build as @Element1.
None of the original man's face, hair or mustache remains unless @Element1 has them.
Keep his outfit, fitted to the new body: open black jacket, white t-shirt, dark trousers, white sneakers.

Keep everything else from @Video1 exactly as it is: every movement and its timing, the handheld camera motion and framing, the bodyguards in black suits, the fans and their phones, the photographer, the street, the SUV, the restaurant, the lighting, the motion blur and the color.
Only this one person changes: no other face changes, no one is added or removed.
When the person walks toward the camera and smiles, the face is sharp, natural and recognizable, with real skin texture and no warping.

post.metadata_comment: Video generee par intelligence artificielle - Cosmos Generator

prompt: You check a photo before it is used in a consensual video effect. Reply with one JSON object only, no prose, with these fields:
people_count: number of clearly visible people;
face_visible: true if one face is clearly visible and roughly faces the camera;
face_sharp: true if that face is sharp and well lit;
face_covered: true if sunglasses, a mask or hands hide part of the face;
full_body: true if the person is visible from head to feet;
apparent_adult: true if the person clearly looks 18 or older;
sexual_content: true if there is nudity or sexual content;
is_photo: true for a real photograph, false for a drawing, 3D render, meme or screenshot;
famous_person: true if this looks like a widely known public figure (never name them).

refuse_if.message: Cette photo ne peut pas être utilisée.
La personne doit être majeure : cette photo est refusée.
Les photos de personnalités publiques sont refusées.
Il faut une vraie photo, pas un dessin ni une capture d'écran.
Il faut une seule personne sur chaque photo.
On ne voit pas bien le visage : choisis une photo de face.
Le visage est en partie caché (lunettes de soleil, main…) : choisis une autre photo.
Le visage est flou ou trop sombre : choisis une photo plus nette.

prompt: Image 1 is a photo of a person. Image 2 should show that same person walking toward the camera in a street, in an open black jacket and white t-shirt. Reply with one JSON object only, no prose, with these fields:
same_person: "yes", "no" or "unsure", comparing facial structure, hair and skin tone;
old_mustache: true if the walking person has a thick mustache although the person in image 1 has none;
face_warped: true if the walking person's face is deformed;
limbs_broken: true if arms, hands or legs are missing, doubled or deformed;
note: under 20 words.

Image 1 is a photo of a person. Image 2 is a sheet of frames, one per second in reading order, from a generated video where a person in an open black jacket and white t-shirt gets out of a black SUV and walks to a restaurant. That person should be the one from image 1. Reply with one JSON object only, no prose, with these fields:
same_person: "yes", "no" or "unsure", comparing facial structure, hair and skin tone;
old_mustache: true if the person has a thick mustache although the person in image 1 has none;
face_warped: true if a face is melted or deformed in any frame;
limbs_broken: true if arms, hands or legs are missing, doubled or deformed;
silhouette_left: true if rainbow false colors remain anywhere;
note: under 20 words.
